text:
ravi: waiver wire heroics. woke up to see @zoe grabbed the rookie WR at 2am? how did you even know he was droppable? :eyes:
zoe: lol snooped the injury thread and saw the coach comments. gamble paid off. also shoutout to the waiver algorithm (and caffeine). :coffee:
claire: congrats! already trash-talking in the league chat. marc is furious he missed the claim by 3 priority points. :joy:
marc: barely awake, phone died in the middle of the bid. i boxed myself out. plotting revenge. who wants a friendly $10 loser brings wings next meetup?
ravi: i'm down. but losers also have to do a 30s touchdown dance on camera at the watch party. :dancer:
ops-bot: Reminder: waiver claim deadline is 1861240800 (Sunday 2:00pm). Automated summary will post after processing. :robot_face:
zoe: also for the watch party — rooftop or conference room? rooftop if not windy. bringing a portable speaker.
claire: rooftop sounds fun. i'll bring folding chairs. marc can bring hot sauce for the wings when he inevitably loses. :sweat_smile:
marc: that's a dangerous dare. also can someone link the league standings? i need to stop pretending i'm fine.
ravi: standings: https://fantasy.example/league/42/standings (updated after waivers).
zoe: psa: don't auto-bid on desperation. let the waiver system work for you. learned that the hard way last year.
claire: tiny poll: who wants wings + veggie platter? react with :chicken: for wings, :leafy_green: for veg, or both.
marc: :chicken: (i accept my fate)
zoe: :both:
ravi: :chicken: and i'll DJ the touchdown playlist.
ops-bot: Poll results recorded. Have fun and good luck, managers! :soccer:
